description: Read localisation in every language the game and mod ship. key: one key per language with file, line and layer, the languages lacking it and the files mentioning it. audit: keys the mod uses that no language defines, keys missing from a supported language, keys defined twice in one language, and file problems. coverage: keys per language. Example: {"mode":"key","key":"my_event.1.t"} or {"mode":"audit"}. Returns counts per problem and a few examples of each.
name: hoi4.localisation_inspect
title: Check localisation in every language
